description: The sloshing tank with a porous column (B 270, x 0.25-0.35 m, n 0.4, d50 2 cm) through the free surface and through the top of a static refined band (z 0.24-0.32 m), G 28 3, G 17 1: the weight of a face of the patch edge with its density without the porosity factor (cfd_amr_cf::rog). To 1 s the largest velocity is 0.29 m/s (1.62 m/s without G 17; 0.29 m/s with the whole tank fine); still water at 9e-7 m/s.
covers: G 17 1 with a porous structure at the top of a patch: rog
